# War Scroll Column 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 15 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**15:1** For this is the-time of-trouble for-Israel, and-the-appointed-time of-war against all the-nations. For-the-lot of-God there-is

**15:2** eternal redemption, and-annihilation for-all the-lot of-Belial. And-there-shall-be great panic among

**15:3** the-sons of-Japheth, and-Assyria shall-fall with-no-one to-help-him. And-the-dominion of-the-Kittim shall-come-to-an-end,

**15:4** that-wickedness be-brought-low without-remnant, and-there-shall-be-no-survivor of-the-Sons of-Darkness.

**15:5** [...] And-the-Sons of-Righteousness shall-shine to-all the-ends of-the-earth, shining more-and-more until

**15:6** all the-appointed-times of-darkness are-completed. And-in-the-appointed-time of-God, His-exalted-greatness shall-shine

**15:7** for-all the-eternal ages, for-peace and-blessing, glory and-joy, and-length of-days for-all the-Sons of-Light. And-on-the-day

**15:8** when-the-Kittim fall, there-shall-be a-battle and-fierce-destruction before-the-God of-Israel. For that is the-day

**15:9** appointed by-Him from-of-old for-the-war of-annihilation against-the-Sons of-Darkness. On-that-day the-congregation of-the-angels

**15:10** and-the-assembly of-men shall-engage together for-great-destruction. The-Sons of-Light and-the-lot of-Darkness shall-fight together

**15:11** [...] for-the-might of-God, amid-the-shouting of-a-great-multitude and-the-war-cry of-angels and-men on-the-day of-calamity.

**15:12** It-shall-be a-time of-tri[bulation for-the-peo]ple redeemed by-God. Of-all their-tribulations, none shall-be like-this,

**15:13** from-its-haste until-eternal redemption is-complete. And-on-the-day of-their-battle against-the-Kittim,

**15:14** they-shall-go-forth for-great-destruction in-battle. [...] three lots the-Sons of-Light shall-stand-firm to-strike-down

**15:15** wickedness, and-three lots Belial shall-strengthen-himself to-turn-back the-lot of [...] And-the-infantry-battalions

**15:16** shall-melt the-heart [...] but-the-might of-God shall-strengthen the-he[art of-the-Sons of-Light.] And-in-the-seventh lot

**15:17** the-great-hand of-God shall-subdue [Belial and-all] the-angels of-his-dominion and-all the-men of [his-lot.]

---

*EMET notes: Column 15 is the exhortation before the final battle. Significantly fragmentary in places. The eschatological timetable is laid out: three lots for each side with the seventh being decisive (15:14-17). "Sons of Japheth" (15:2) alludes to Genesis 10 ethnic geography. Kittim fall is the climactic event. The angelic-human joint battle (15:9-11) is a distinctive 1QM theme. Lacunae marked with [...] where manuscript is damaged.*
